supersedes.reason: The second independent review confirmed four prior finding groups but showed that follow-up manifests could omit changed files or forge their incremental base, while DONE status could excuse newly inserted unverified items. This manifest binds the complete correction and its legacy-only migration policy.

checks.result: The exact second review-fix commit passed repository, runtime, architecture, agent-protocol, ADR, CI, formatting, linting, typing, packaging, 67 foundation tests, and canonical backlog validation.
The exact second review-fix commit passed the foundation checks again, all 19 security tests, and a live scan of 31 packages with 30 reported license findings and zero blocking findings.
Complete schema, semantic, hierarchy, lease, dependency, review, release-gate, and stored-evidence validation passed for 20 capabilities, 117 slices, 356 tasks, and 12 release gates.
All 23 focused schema and workflow tests passed, including omitted follow-up files, forged superseding bases, and post-DONE evidence mutation with a recomputed reference hash.

evidence: Every follow-up manifest must identify an earlier attachment with supersedes.path, set baseCommit to that attachment's commit, and declare a changedFiles set exactly equal to the incremental Git diff.
Stored validation no longer derives unverified-item permission from task status or approval. Non-empty unverifiedItems fail for all normal evidence before and after DONE.

The only residual exception is an explicit schema-governed legacy marker on four CAP-00.S03 references; task ID, path, commit, canonical digest, and exact hosted-CI text are fixed in the policy anchor, so recomputing a mutated reference hash or adding the marker elsewhere fails.

The two historical CAP-00.S03 review-fix manifests and the CAP-00.S04.T01 review-fix manifest now explicitly identify the attachment they supersede, use that commit as their incremental base, and declare the exact corresponding diff.

Focused tests attempt to omit one file from a follow-up diff, forge its base to an older ancestor, mutate unverifiedItems after approval while recomputing the stored hash, and apply the legacy marker to an unauthorized path; all attempts are rejected.
All 23 focused tests and 67 foundation tests pass at the exact correction commit, and the security-local profile independently passes 19 security tests plus the zero-blocker live scan.
The backlog schema, planning guide, and Codex tracking guide define exact follow-up scope and the immutable legacy marker boundary consistently with executable behavior.

The migration changes only three historical follow-up manifests and their governed references; original commits remain in Git history, no application feature or dependency changed, and all later-wave scope remains untouched.

reviewerDisposition.note: Independent re-review must reproduce the remaining scope/base/unverified mutations and verify the legacy policy boundary before approval.
